notes.title: Our new game is offically realeased!
notes.content:
Hi dear players of Yetu game, our new Otome game, "My Vow to My Liege" is now offically realeased in BOTH Chinese and English! If you're interested, please come and have a look at it, and you will get the 1st week purchase discount for it! (*However, please note that the1st week discount will be over soon in a few hours, so come and get it if you want it!:) )

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1146970/_/

《My Vow to My Liege》is a visual novel dating game. Players get to play as a girl disguised as the King of Ng, a man. The 4 dateable characters are: the guide, the enemy, the minister and the guard.Will they choose the man over the country? Love over hate? Who will they finally end up with?

notes.title: We can now accept Australian dollars!
notes.content:
We can now accept Australian dollars! We were going to accept it a few days ago, in time for the Steam's Autumn Sale Event but was having problems with our VPN. We have since then, fixed our system and apologise to all our Aussie friends for the long wait.

We are also participating in the Steam's Autumn Sale Event and all our games are now on sale for the week.:aboutlove:

notes.title: A Change of Email Address!
notes.content: After 2 weeks of trying to fix our email server, we have found that our previous email address, service@yetuavg.com can no longer receive any incoming mails and letters. So we have changed our customer service email to 2535104877@qq.com. We are very sorry for the inconvenience and asked that you will sent any future emails to the new email address. In addition to that, if you have sent us any emails within the past two weeks, we asked that you will kindly re-sent us your emails to the new address.

notes.title: 【PRICE sequel "The Endless Journey" English version released!】
notes.content:
Hello everyone. Here is indie game YETU GAME. Our new puzzle game The Endless Journey English version has released on Steam! The address is:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/715650/The_Endless_Journey/

The timeline of this game is at the Ivry siblings childhood time. They will be the NPC in the game. And this time the protagonist is the magician who appeared in PRICE - Mr. Valjean. Is he a good man or bad?

notes.title: New game requires English system testing volunteers.
notes.content:
Greeting every 《PRICE》 English players! Our new game 《The Endless Journey》 will release this Friday. It is prequel of 《PRICE》. The first walkthrough time is about 8 to 10 hours. Iva and Ivey will also present in game.
[h1] [New Game][/h1]http://store.steampowered.com/app/715650/The_Endless_Journey/ 


Now English version has completed, but requires English mother tongue and English windows system players for testing walkthrough. For players who have free time these days please leave your comment in this announcement. We will randomly choose 2 to 3 players for testing the game.  Please for players who leave comments introduce yourself briefly.
[h1] [Requirements][/h1] 
1.English system windows operation system.
2. Free time for three days. 
3.Played 《PRICE》 before. 

If you are non-English system windows which is Chinese system: 
1. Supported Price DLC before. 
2. Know a little Chinese. 

We also welcome for signing up in comments. After testing result come out, we will thank testers for 2 activities keys=3=! Thanks everyone!My English is not so good QAQ

notes.title: PRICE Design Collection English Version Released + 30% Off!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for your support all along. During the Summer Sales, we are releasing:
1. PRICE revised English version; English proofreader: lolaya, German proofreader: Stealth

2. PRICE English Design Collection translated by 三月疯兔子, proofread by Stealth

3. PRICE Japanese version, translated by 悲伤的小鱼

Last year, as Steam newcomers, we made friends with players from all over the world for the very first time. Your kind suggestions have been really helpful. We’ll try to release our up-coming games in both Chinese and English simultaneously (we’re also working hard on other languages!). 

Hope to see you in our new puzzle-solving game, Cosette!
[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26300079/4759341e11e654cf8543a941180c7d80b42ce728.png[/img]

notes.content:
I am so happy to make so many friends on Steam. There are so many players and even hardcore players support us. I am so glad to be liked by everyone. Happy XD! So I am going to randomly choose some lucky players who gave us review or bought DLC to give PRICE tarot or gift or postcards to everyone(I am going to take a look how to sent international transport =3=). The chosen will be in middle of October.

所以组里打算从游戏评论或者购买游戏dlc的玩家中抽取一些朋友们送PRICE的塔罗牌or小周边，还有明信片寄信给大 家（国外的朋友们我会努力研究一下怎么跨国寄信的=3=），10月中旬抽取~

notes.title: Rating mistake
notes.content:
I apologize to Steam and CERO. It is my fault to fill the wrong age rating system and then made troubles to them. Now the game was removed and now is back again. Also apologize to players. About the age rating system, it should ask the age rating organizations to determine. I misunderstood the system and then chose a rating by myself. Because this is my first time to meet this so I did not do the right thing. I should ask others for more information. 
I apologize again to Steam and CERO and thanks to the tolerance.
